meta.title: Whose Backpack Is It?
meta.textType: story: finding a person from a description

paragraphs: On Friday, June nineteenth, sports class finished at two o'clock. Lily and Mia walked across the school field. At the edge of the field, they saw a green backpack on a bench. Nobody was near it. There was no name on the bag, and the front pocket was empty. "Whose bag is it?" asked Mia. "I don't know," said Lily. "Maybe somebody forgot it." "Now he is looking for his missing backpack."

Coach Matt came over with his silver whistle. "Does this bag belong to a boy from your class?" asked Lily. "A boy sat on that bench before sports," said Coach Matt. "Can you describe him?" asked Mia. "He is thin and tall, and he has curly hair," said Coach Matt. "He wears a blue team shirt with a white stripe and a black belt."

Four children were on the field. A girl in a yellow shirt stood by the gate. A boy in a blue shirt sat under a tree and ate an orange. A small boy in a green shirt stood at the water tap. Another boy ran near the goal. "The boy under the tree has a blue shirt," said Mia. "His shirt has no stripe," said Lily. "The girl is not a boy, and the small boy is not tall," said Mia.

Lily looked at the boy near the goal. "I guess he is the owner," she said. "He has curly hair, and his shirt has a white stripe." "I can see a black belt, too," said Mia. "He is the owner, isn't he?" Lily asked Coach Matt. "Yes, he is," said Coach Matt, and he waved to the boy.

The boy ran across the field to the bench. He gave the girls a friendly smile. "Thank you!" he said. "I didn't know where I left my bag." "I am so lucky!" Lily gave him the backpack, and Mia waved goodbye.
text.summary: Lily and Mia find a green backpack on a bench after sports. Coach Matt describes the owner, and the girls find the boy by his clothes and hair.
